name: A Daisy By Any Other Name
source:
Fourteen-year-old Daisy is at the local fair when she realizes she doesn’t want to be named Daisy anymore. But if she isn’t Daisy...then who is she?

[From [url=https://omegabutton.itch.io/a-daisy-by-any-other-name]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十四岁的黛西在当地的集市上，意识到自己不想再被称为黛西了。但如果她不是黛西……那么她是谁？

[来自[url=https://omegabutton.itch.io/a-daisy-by-any-other-name]itch.io[/url]]
